mechanism.claim: The managed onshore yuan is a direct China-risk channel. A completed 01:30-02:00 UTC USD/CNY morning repricing toward yuan weakness signals regional risk stress and maps short BTC; yuan strength maps long BTC, only when BTC is already in a high realized-variation regime.
mechanism.side: negative sign of completed USDCNY 01:30-02:00 UTC log return

external_support.economic_channel: the onshore yuan is managed but tradable, and USD/CNY appreciation represents yuan weakness and China-linked risk stress
external_support.untested_adaptation: the completed onshore-China morning repricing is tested as a twelve-hour BTC relay

mechanism.why_distinct: EMDFR used USDCNY only as one leg of a three-country 13:00-16:00 UTC common-dollar median and never isolated the China morning channel. CYMRR uses a fixed 01:30-02:00 UTC onshore-yuan repricing, no prior event set or control, and no crypto flow, funding, OI, or premium.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-24h realized variation must rank at least 0.65 causally
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: weekday 02:05 UTC entries conditioned on the China morning yuan channel are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: exact USDCNY Polygon 1m bars [01:30,02:00) UTC on each Monday-Friday; all 30 timestamps required
features.fx_return: log(close of 01:59 minute/open of 01:30 minute); zero is ineligible
features.availability: 02:00 UTC after all 30 source bars complete
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in the prior 24 elapsed hours ending at decision
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 previous valid weekday decision variations; minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.missing_duplicate_or_nonpositive: ineligible or source failure; no imputation

clock.decision: each Monday-Friday 02:00 UTC with complete FX and BTC source paths
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent onshore-China morning risk channel plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no session, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
